title: registry.auth.refresh_reuse_detected payload (v1)
description: Security audit AUTH_REFRESH_REUSE: an invalidated refresh token was presented, so its whole family was revoked. Ids only; no secrets or password data. Producer: registry. Exchange: aegispulse.domain. FRs: FR-AUTH-02, FR-AUD-02. Describes only the envelope `payload` (PROJECT.md §6.4, §6.7); consumers ignore unknown fields (NFR-13).
